# Gen for Salesforce and envelope templates as files

## Contents

- How Gen works
- The Gen template spec
- The lint
- The envelope template spec
- Deploy, generate and send
- Proof
- Not proven or not modelled

Docusign Gen for Salesforce makes agreements from a Salesforce record inside Salesforce. This repo writes a
**Gen template** and an **eSignature for Salesforce envelope template** as small JSON specs, compiles them, and
deploys them to an org by the REST API. Everything below was measured in the lab account Developer Edition org
(Docusign Apps Launcher `dfsle` 8.8, connected to the lab account, account 49974489) on 2026-11-06, unless a
line says **docs** (Docusign's help, not tried).

| What | File | Compiles to |
|---|---|---|
| Gen template | `assets/salesforce-gen-templates/specs/<id>.json` | a Word file with Gen `<# … #>` tags per document, the ObjectMappings JSON, the `dfsle__GenTemplate__c` record, the per-file settings on `ContentVersion` |
| Envelope template | `assets/salesforce-envelope-templates/specs/<id>.json` | `dfsle__EnvelopeConfiguration__c` with its recipient and document records, and an optional button |
| Compilers | `src/salesforce-gen-spec.ts`, `src/salesforce-envelope-spec.ts` | also the lint for any Gen Word file |
| Deploy, generate, send, clean up | `captures/sf-gen-deploy.ts` | dry run by default; ledger `captures/sf-gen/LEDGER.jsonl` |
| The org's fields | `assets/salesforce/describe.json` | a slim read-only describe the offline compile and lint use |

## How Gen works

A Gen template is a Salesforce record plus one or more Word files attached to it. Its **ObjectMappings** JSON
lists the fields and related lists to read. At generation Docusign's Gen service builds one SOQL query from the
mapping, turns the record into XML, and merges the Word file's tags with XPath 1.0. The file lands in the
record's Files as Word or PDF. Sending is a separate eSignature step: a linked envelope template, a Flow, or a
person.

Three facts shape the compiler:

- **Only mapped fields exist.** A tag that reads an unmapped field prints a red error in the document
  (`XPathException … returned no results`), and generation still "succeeds". So the compiler **derives the
  mapping from the paths the body uses**: a spec cannot print a field the mapping lacks.
- **Values arrive as formatted text.** Currency is `$1,720.00`, dates follow the mapping's format, checkboxes are
  `True`/`False` (capital T), numbers `120.00`. A number comparison strips the formatting first; a checkbox
  compares with `'True'`; the format sits on the mapping, not the tag (XSLT `format-number()` fails).
- **Errors print inside the document.** The deploy script reads every generated file back and fails on
  `TemplateErrorExists`, `XPathException` or a leftover `<#`.

## The Gen template spec

```json
{
  "id": "order-form-opportunity",
  "name": "Order Form (Opportunity)",
  "sourceObject": "Opportunity",
  "fields": { "CloseDate": { "format": "MMMM D, YYYY" } },
  "lists": { "OpportunityLineItems": { "orderBy": "TotalPrice DESC", "max": 50, "filter": "Quantity > 0" } },
  "partyName": "Account.Name",
  "documents": [{
    "file": "Fontara_Order_Form.docx",
    "output": { "name": "Fontara Order Form", "suffix": "name_date", "format": "PDF" },
    "rule": { "match": "all", "conditions": [{ "field": "StageName", "notEquals": "Closed Lost" }] },
    "header": "Fontara Order Form · {{Name}}",
    "footer": "Confidential · Page {page} of {pages}",
    "body": [ … ]
  }]
}
```

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sourceObject` | The root object: the record the Flow action or button generates from. |
| `fields` | A format per field path (dates: `MMMM D, YYYY`, `dddd, MMMM D, YYYY`; currency: `symbol`; numbers: `integer` or `decimal`, applied in the tag because Gen has no number format: a count-like field with decimals in the org (quantity, seats, users, licenses) defaults to `integer`, `4,000` not `4,000.00`, and the lint warns when a hand-made file prints one raw), and fields to map that the body does not print. Dates default to `MMMM D, YYYY`, currency to `symbol`. A DATETIME needs a format: with none, generation fails. |
| `lists` | Per related list: SOQL `orderBy`, `max` (LIMIT 1–2000) and `filter` (WHERE), `fields` (a format per row field), and `lists`: the related lists of each row, with the same keys (two levels at most, as Gen allows: `"SBQQ__Quotes2__r": { "filter": "SBQQ__Primary__c = true", "lists": { "SBQQ__LineItems__r": { "orderBy": "SBQQ__NetTotal__c DESC" } } }`). A filter naming a field the org lacks fails the whole run. |
| `partyName` | The party name for Agreement Manager (`AgreementMetadata__c`). |
| `button` | `{ "label" }`: a custom button (WebLink) on the source object that opens the Gen generator with this template (`sf-gen-deploy --buttons`; with `--on` the deploy presses it on that record). A person adds it to the page layout. |
| `documents[]` | Up to 10 Word files. `output.name` is the generated file's prefix (without one Gen prints `null_…`); `suffix` adds the record name, the date or both; `format` is `Word` or `PDF`. |
| `documents[].rule` | Generate this file only when the rule holds: `equals` / `notEquals` on the source object's own fields (picklist, text, number, date, checkbox, currency, email, phone, URL). No commas or quotes in values. |

**Body blocks.** Text takes `{{Path}}` (`Amount`, `Account.Name`, `Account.Owner.Name`; in a table row or a `repeat`, a
field of the row: `Quantity`, `Product2.Name`), `{{Path?}}` (prints nothing when the value is missing), `{{= <XPath 1.0>}}`
(prints an expression, e.g. a line's discount `{{= round(100 - 100 * number(translate(./UnitPrice,'$,','')) div
number(translate(./ListPrice,'$,','')))}}%`) and `**bold**`. Every field a raw XPath reads (`{{= …}}` or a `test`) is
mapped like any other.

| Block | Word output |
|---|---|
| `{ "title" }`, `{ "h" }`, `{ "p", "align"? }`, `{ "bullets": [] }` | paragraphs |
| `{ "fields": [[label, value], …] }` | a two-column key-terms table |
| `{ "table": { "rows": "<related list>", "where"?, "columns": [{ "header", "value", "width"?, "align"?, "showIf"? }], "hideRowIf"?, "footer"? } }` | a table whose row repeats per record (`TableRow`); `where` is an XPath predicate on the rows; `showIf` shows a cell's value only when true; `hideRowIf` drops a row (`SuppressTableRow`); `footer` is a static last row (root paths) |
| `{ "repeat": { "rows": "<related list>", "where"?, "body": [] } }` | `Repeat` … `EndRepeat` (each tag in its own paragraph): the body once per row, in the row's scope. Inside it, a `table` or `repeat` on one of the row's own lists reads `.//<list>` (a list of each row) |
| `{ "if": cond, "then": [], "else": [] }` | `Conditional` … `EndConditional`, each tag in its own paragraph (a false block leaves no blank line); `else` is the negated condition |
| `{ "pageBreak": true }` | a page break (inside an `if`, a conditional page break) |
| `{ "image": { "url", "width", "height" } }` | `Image` (inches, https URL) |
| `{ "signature": { "signer": 1, "label", "fields": ["s","n","t","d"] } }` | a signature block: `Signature Placeholder="\s1\" Hidden="true"` per field (`s` signature, `i` initials, `d` date signed, `n` name, `c` company, `t` title), and the template's SignerMappings |

**Conditions** (`if`, `showIf`, `hideRowIf`):

| Condition | Compiles to |
|---|---|
| `{ "field": "Type", "equals": "New Customer" }` (or `notEquals`) | `<Conditional Select="/Opportunity/Type" Match="New Customer"/>` — what the wizard writes |
| `{ "field": "Type", "in": ["A", "B"] }` | `Test="/Opportunity/Type = 'A' or …"` |
| `{ "field": "IsPrivate", "isTrue": true }` | `Test="/Opportunity/IsPrivate = 'True'"` |
| `{ "field": "Amount", "gte": 250000 }` (`gt`, `lt`, `lte`) | `Test="number(translate(/Opportunity/Amount,'$,','')) >= 250000"` |
| `{ "field": "NextStep", "empty": true }` | `Test="string-length(/Opportunity/NextStep) = 0"` |
| `{ "count": "OpportunityLineItems", "gt": 2 }` | `Test="count(/Opportunity//OpportunityLineItems) > 2"` |
| `{ "all": [] }`, `{ "any": [] }`, `{ "not": c }`, `{ "test": "<XPath>" }` | `and`, `or`, `not()`, a raw XPath 1.0 test (the lint still checks its paths) |

The compiler refuses a picklist value the org does not have, a checkbox compared with a string, a number
comparison on a field that is not a number, a lookup id printed as a value, and an unknown key.

### The mapping it writes

Measured live, including two shapes the wizard's notes did not cover:

| Data | ObjectMappings | XML element / XPath |
|---|---|---|
| Root field | a field of the `ROOT` block | `/Opportunity/Amount` |
| Lookup field | a `REFERENCE` field on the parent block and a block keyed `Account`, path `["Account"]` | `/Opportunity/Account.Name` (flat, dotted) |
| Lookup two levels up | a block keyed **`Account.Owner`** (the dotted path), path `["Account","Owner"]`, depth 3 | `/Opportunity/Account.Owner.Name` |
| Related list | a `CHILD_RELATIONSHIP` field (with `orderBy`, `maximumRecords`, `filterBy`) and a block keyed `OpportunityLineItems` | `/Opportunity//OpportunityLineItems` |
| Lookup from a row | a block keyed **`OpportunityLineItems.Product2`** whose path starts at the row, `["Product2"]` | `./Product2.Name` in the row |
| List of each row (2nd level) | a `CHILD_RELATIONSHIP` field on the first list's block and a block keyed **`SBQQ__Quotes2__r.SBQQ__LineItems__r`**, path `["SBQQ__LineItems__r"]`, depth 3 (2026-11-23) | `.//SBQQ__LineItems__r` in a quote row; XML `<SBQQ__Quotes2__r><SBQQ__LineItems__r_Container><SBQQ__LineItems__r>` |
| Lookup from a 2nd-level row | a block keyed `SBQQ__Quotes2__r.SBQQ__LineItems__r.SBQQ__Product__r`, path `["SBQQ__Product__r"]`, depth 4 | `./SBQQ__Product__r.Name` in a line row |

A lookup block keyed by its last name only (`Owner`) fails the run ("The given key 'Account.Owner_3_REFERENCE' was
not present"); a row lookup whose path starts at the root fails with a SOQL error; a 2nd-level list block keyed by its
relationship alone (`SBQQ__LineItems__r`, path `[]`) fails it with "Object reference not set to an instance of an object"
(Docusign Logs).

**To see the merge XML** Gen builds, print element names: `<# <Content Select="name(/Opportunity/*[3])" Optional="true"/> #>`
prints the third element's name (`SBQQ__Quotes2__r_Container`), and `name(./*[n])` does the same in a row. Gen evaluates any
XPath 1.0 expression in `Select`, so this is how the 2nd-level shape above was read.

The template record also carries the locale fields (`templateLocale__c` "Generator's Locale" and the
`USER` currency fields). **Without them generation fails: "No user Locale info passed in payload".**

### Tag text Gen parses as XML

A Gen tag is parsed as XML. A bare `&` in a value (`Match="UK & Europe"`) prints "There was an error parsing
this merge tag as XML … EntityName", and the paragraph's `EndConditional` then has no partner. The compiler writes
`&amp;`; the lint flags a bare `&`. Tag names are case-sensitive: `Html`, not `HTML`.

## The lint

`lintGenDocx(docx, mappings)` reads any Gen Word file — this compiler's or one written by hand in Word — and
`lintMappings(mappings, describe)` reads the mapping against the org. From the command line, before uploading a
Word file made by hand:

```
npm run gen:lint -- <file.docx> --spec=<spec id>              # against the mapping a spec compiles to
npm run gen:lint -- <file.docx> --mappings=<ObjectMappings.json> [--signers=<n>]   # against a template record's JSON
``` `compileSfGenTemplate` runs both on its own
output and refuses to compile if either finds an error; the deploy script runs them again against the org's live
describe before it writes.

| Check | Why |
|---|---|
| Tag names, case-sensitive; `Conditional`/`Repeat`/`Group`/`TrackedContent` closed | a misspelled tag prints a red error |
| Every path a `Select` or `Test` reads is mapped: root fields, row fields inside a `TableRow` or `Repeat`, rows inside a list predicate | an unmapped path prints `XPathException` (a warning when the tag is `Optional`) |
| A checkbox compared with `'true'` | the value is `True` |
| A currency field compared or summed without `translate()` | the value is `$1,720.00` |
| `format-number()` | XSLT, fails |
| A bare `&` in a tag | the tag fails to parse |
| Every mapped field exists in the org with its type; lists and lookups exist; `orderBy`/`filterBy` name real fields | a missing field fails the whole run with a SOQL error |
| DATETIME with no format | generation fails ("Object reference not set…") |
| Lookup blocks keyed by their dotted path; a 2nd-level list block keyed by its chain | see above |
| At most two levels of related lists | Gen's limit |
| Signature anchors ≤ the SignerMappings count | |

## The envelope template spec

```json
{
  "id": "order-form-gen-send",
  "name": "Order Form (Gen & Send)",
  "sourceObject": "Opportunity",
  "sending": "send",
  "emailSubject": "Please sign your Fontara Order Form",
  "documents": [{ "gen": "order-form-opportunity", "sendAfterGenerate": true }],
  "recipients": [
    { "role": "Customer", "from": { "relatedList": "OpportunityContactRoles", "filter": "Role = 'Decision Maker' AND IsPrimary = true", "max": 1 } },
    { "role": "Fontara", "from": { "fixed": { "name": "Fontara Deal Desk", "email": "fontara.deal-desk@example.com" } } }
  ],
  "onEvents": { "sent": { "Opportunity.StageName": "Negotiation/Review" }, "completed": { "Opportunity.StageName": "Closed Won" } },
  "writeBack": { "nameFormat": "Name", "includeCertificateOfCompletion": true },
  "reminders": { "delayDays": 2, "frequencyDays": 2 },
  "expiration": { "afterDays": 30, "warnDays": 5 },
  "button": { "label": "Send Order Form" }
}
```

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sending` | `edit` (Default: the sender reviews, `Action__c` Prepare), `tag` (Place Fields) or `send` (Send Now: nobody in the loop). Quick Send is not modelled. |
| `documents[]` | `{ "gen": "<Gen spec id>", "sendAfterGenerate"? }`: the Gen template links to this envelope template (`GenTemplate.EnvelopeConfiguration__c`), and with `sendAfterGenerate` (`HasLaunchAutomatically__c`) generating also sends (Send Now only); or `{ "file": "<repo path>", "name"? }` (uploaded to the template). `{ "recordFiles": … }` (the record's own Files) is refused until the wizard's stored filter is harvested: a guessed one made the send fail. |
| `recipients[]` | `role`, `type` (Signer, CarbonCopy, …), `routingOrder` (default: in order), and `from`: a related list with `filter`/`orderBy`/`max`, a person `lookup` on the record (`Owner`), a `fixed` name and email, or the `sender`. `signNow: true` is "Initiate Signing After Sending (Sign Now)": on an `InPersonSigner`, or on the `sender` as the first Signer; the first recipient must have it (help sjz1629349704101; compiled 2026-11-09, unproven: [nda-in-person-sign-now](../assets/salesforce-envelope-templates/specs/nda-in-person-sign-now.json)). At most four signers: AutoPlace anchors serve signers 1–4. |
| `onEvents` | Field updates on the source record per envelope event (`sent`, `delivered`, `completed`, `declined`, `voided`), at most 5 per event and 25 in all; values are checked against the org's picklists. |
| `writeBack` | Save the completed documents to the record (`nameFormat`, certificate, combine). |
| `button` | A custom button (WebLink) on the source object that opens sending with this template; deployed with the Metadata API; a person adds it to the layout. |

Tabs come from the document: Gen prints AutoPlace anchors (`\s1\`, `\d1\` …) in white, and every envelope
template the compiler writes has `includeDefaultAutoPlaceTags`. **The anchors place tabs only for a role named
`Signer <N>`** (the package maps that name to the role's AutoPlace number N): with the roles named Customer, Counterparty
or Fontara, five lab envelopes reached their signers with no tabs at all, and the invite opened free-form signing
(2026-11-06 to 2026-11-09). So the compiler stores the Nth signer's role as `Signer <N>`; the spec's `role` names the
person in the spec only. `--send` checks every signer's tabs on the sent envelope (gate `tabs`; it reads the envelope
through the Docusign browser session, so `DS_ACCOUNT` must be the sending account's profile).

## Deploy, generate and send

```
npx tsx captures/sf-gen-deploy.ts <spec ids>                    # dry run: compile, lint, write dist/salesforce-gen/<id>/
DEPLOY_LAB=1 npx tsx captures/sf-gen-deploy.ts <ids> --apply --org=SET-YOUR-SALESFORCE-ORG-ID --docusign-account=49974489 \
    [--buttons] [--on=Opportunity="ZZ Lab · …"] [--on=Account="ZZ Lab · …"] [--send] [--void] [--report]
npx tsx captures/sf-gen-deploy.ts --cleanup [--apply --org=…]   # void what was sent, delete what the ledger lists
```

- `--demo-record` lets `--on` name a demo record (not "ZZ Lab"): generate and read back only; `--send` and `--sign` still
  need a ZZ Lab record. The generated files are ledgered and `--cleanup` deletes them.
- `--apply` checks the org id and reads the Docusign account off Docusign Setup ▸ Connected Account before any
  write; it refuses another org or account. The lab writes "ZZ Lab · …" names only.
- **Idempotent by name.** A redeploy updates our own ledgered records (a Word file only gets a new version when
  its bytes changed: Salesforce's MD5 checksum); a same-named record the ledger did not create is refused.
- `--on` generates every Gen template of that object once on a "ZZ Lab" record (the Flow action
  `dfsle__InvocableDocumentGenerationRequest` by REST), reads each file back (PDF through `pdftotext`, plus a
  picture of page 1) and fails on any error text, leftover tag, or a printed record value missing from the output.
  The Jobs row stays "In Progress" long after the file lands, so the script watches the record's Files.
- `--send` resolves every recipient first and refuses anything that is not a lab inbox (a lab deploy
  rewrites the cast's `fontara.<x>@example.com` to `zz-lab.<x>@example.com`). A Gen template linked with
  `sendAfterGenerate` is sent by the package's scheduler; other envelope templates are sent with the Flow action
  **Send With DocuSign** (`dfsle__EnvelopeConfigurationBulkRequest`). Gen & Send generates from Apex (a REST-started
  generation was not sent). It then checks the `sent` field updates.
- `--void` voids each envelope with the Apex Toolkit (`dfsle.StatusService.voidEnvelope`, anonymous Apex).

## Proof

Run on 2026-11-06 in the lab account org (`SET-YOUR-SALESFORCE-ORG-ID`, Docusign account 49974489 read off Docusign Setup),
on the ZZ Lab Opportunity "ZZ Lab · Gen Builder renewal" (three products, one discounted; a Decision Maker contact
role with a lab-inbox email) and its Account "ZZ Lab · Gen Builder Co" (Fontara UK Ltd, UK & Europe, Technology
Partner). Reports: `assets/salesforce-gen-templates/verify/` and `assets/salesforce-envelope-templates/verify/`.

| Spec | Result |
|---|---|
| `order-form-opportunity` | PDF generated, every tag rendered: entity and address from the Account, the product table with "Your price" only on the discounted line, the Discounts, special-terms and personal-data clauses, the order total. Page 1: `assets/salesforce-gen-templates/verify/order-form-opportunity.png`. |
| `msa-opportunity` | Two Word files (MSA, and the DPA because the rule `Personal_Data__c = Yes` held); the UK entity, England and Wales law, SCC clause and the non-Strategic liability cap. |
| `nda-account` | PDF; the one-way branch for a Prospect and the mutual branch for a Technology Partner (page 1: `nda-account.png`). |
| `order-form-gen-send` | Gen & Send: generating the Order Form sent it (the generated PDF, Customer = the Decision Maker, then Fontara Deal Desk); the scheduler sent it about 20 minutes later. Stage moved Proposal/Price Quote → Negotiation/Review on send; voided with the Apex Toolkit, Voided synced back. |
| `nda-send` | Send With DocuSign (Flow action by REST) sent the uploaded standard NDA to the Account's newest contact, then Fontara Legal, within seconds; `DPA_In_Place__c` written on send; voided. |
| `msa-send` | Deployed with its button (WebLink `Opportunity.ZZ_Lab_Send_MSA_with_Docusign`), linked to the MSA Gen template; pressed 2026-11-09: the sending page opened with no documents (see Buttons below). |
| `nda-review-and-send` | Its button on a ZZ Lab Account opened the sending page with the NDA, the Account's newest contact and the sender (2026-11-09); not sent. |

Run on 2026-11-23 (Apps Launcher 8.8) on the org's demo records with `--demo-record`, generate only: the Opportunities
"Nesis Biotech — Order Form" (primary CPQ quote Q-00000: 36 months, 4,000 users at $1,325 against $1,720 list, Net 30)
and "Pine Care — Renewal Order Form" (Q-00001: 12 months at list, Net 90), and their Accounts.

| Spec | Result |
|---|---|
| `order-form-discount-term` | Nesis: the line's discount printed by `{{= round(…)}}` (23%), the Discount approval clause (a line more than 15% below list), Multi-year commitment from the quote's term and dates (a lookup, `SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.…`, two levels for the contact). Pine Care: no discount text, Term and renewal, the Net 90 Finance line. Page 1: `verify/order-form-discount-term.png`. |
| `nda-account-counterparty` | Nesis (Strategic): five-year term, DPA clause, New York law, notices to the signatory read from the Account's Contacts (`repeat`, LIMIT 1); no group paragraph (no parent account: a `Test` on a missing lookup is simply false). Pine Care (Enterprise): three-year term. |
| `sow-quote-opportunity` | Two levels of related lists: the primary quote (`repeat` on `SBQQ__Quotes2__r`, WHERE `SBQQ__Primary__c = true`) with its line table (`.//SBQQ__LineItems__r`, each line's Product by a lookup from the line) and the quote total from the quote row; the contact roles table; the multi-year paragraph per quote. Page 1: `verify/sow-quote-opportunity.png`. |

The generated files were deleted afterwards (`--cleanup`); the templates were removed the same way.

Measured on the way (each now a compiler rule or a lint check): the dotted lookup block keys, the row lookup path,
the locale fields, `&amp;` in tags; a SourceFiles document with a guessed filter fails the send ("Argument is
undefined"); the Jobs row stays "In Progress" after the file lands; a Gen & Send generation started through the REST
actions endpoint ended "Not Applicable" while the same template generated from Apex was sent. All ZZ Lab records,
files and both envelopes were removed or voided after the run (`captures/sf-gen/LEDGER.jsonl`).

## Not proven or not modelled

- **Buttons.** An envelope template's button opens Docusign's sending page with the template's documents and
  recipients (nda-review-and-send, pressed on a ZZ Lab Account 2026-11-09; `--buttons --on` presses it, Send is not
  pressed). On a Gen-linked envelope template (msa-send) the same button opens sending with no documents: generated
  files reach sending only through the Gen generator's Send for Signature, so give such a template's Gen spec the button.
- **Wizard round trip.** An API-made Gen template generates; whether the Gen wizard opens it cleanly is not checked.
- Agreement Cloud Editor (`Online Editor`) templates, Quick Send envelope templates, `Group`, `TableColumn`
  and `RichText` blocks (the tags work live — see the vault note — but the spec has no block for them;
  a hand-made Word file using them still lints).
- Lookups two levels deep from a table row (one level is proven, from a first- and a second-level list).

writes: [LAB-RULES.md](LAB-RULES.md).
